item.title: Anomalous structure idea: May This House
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror

Page Layout
Standard article with a few pretty long logs that comprise most of the page

Elevator Pitch:
An anomalous house that presents those who enter with one of four scenarios, based on the family that lives there.

Central Narrative:
A member of a family dies. The family, unbeknownst to them, had been living in an anomalous house, which warps their grief into terrifying anomalous power, though it is mostly contained within the house. The foundation discovers the house, and investigates, sending four teams in made of both MTF members and D-Class to investigate the four scenarios.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
The four different scenarios are pretty unique, and the logs provide most of the horror and slowly reveal what happened at this house.
